title: get_messages — paginated message retrieval (worker surface; get_session_messages is an alias here)
description: Domain: session/message. Sources: worker src/worker_rpc.rs:1596 (match arm 'get_messages' | 'get_session_messages'); host intercept src/bin/ion.rs:7893; host direct read host_direct_session_read src/bin/ion.rs:6861/6971. Data shape identical on all three surfaces. Wire envelope (validated separately, not by this schema): worker replies {"id","type":"response","command","success":true,"data":<this payload>} (src/worker_rpc.rs output_response); host replies {"type":"response","id","success":true,"data":<this payload>,"session"?}. Errors use {"success":false,"error":string} with no data.

items.description: Arbitrary JSON object (entry/Message payload, not contracted here)

messages.description: message/branch_summary JSONL entries on the requested page.

view.description: Echo of the applied view, lowercased Debug format, e.g. live/full/since_compaction/branch(..).

items.description: Arbitrary JSON object (entry/Message payload, not contracted here)

after.description: Cursor: return entries strictly after this entry id.

before.description: Cursor: return entries strictly before this entry id.

from.description: Only "head" is meaningful: page from the oldest entry forward. Any other value is treated as absent (worker_rpc.rs:1627).

complete_turn.description: Trim the page to whole turns.

oneOf.description: branch:<name>: read only that branch's path.

session.description: Session id or .jsonl file path. Required on the HOST direct-read surface; ignored by the worker surface (worker is bound to its session).
